backend-engineering-edho-ferdian.description: Agent form of the backend-engineering-edho-ferdian skill, same triggers — delegate here when the task justifies isolated or parallel execution; a small task should use the skill directly instead. Authoring server-side code between the API contract and the datastore — layering and ports/adapters boundaries, error taxonomy and resilience (typed errors, Result style, retry with backoff, circuit breakers), background jobs and queues, structured logging emission, and adding a new integration that matches the repo's existing connector pattern. The backend counterpart to frontend-engineering-edho-ferdian. Trigger phrases: "struktur service layer", "error handling di backend", "retry/circuit breaker", "background job / queue", "tambah integrasi baru".
